summary: Put Ansible projects in source control, preferably git, for an audit trail, rollback, history and shared maintenance.
questions: Should I keep my Ansible playbooks in git?

answer_card.title: Use git for Ansible projects
answer_card.answer_md: Yes. Put inventory, roles and playbooks under source control; git is recommended. You get an audit trail, can roll back mistakes, view history, and share the maintenance work.
